items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 7 at 1:17PM AKDT until October 8 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 65 mph
expected.

* WHERE...St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 10 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may damage property and cause power outages.
Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 7 at 1:17PM AKDT until October 10 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 10 to 14
inches for areas of elevation. Winds occasionally gusting as high
as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Noatak Valley and South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range.

* WHEN...From midnight Thursday Night to 10 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility.
items.areas: South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range; Noatak Valley
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water with
you in case of an emergency.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 7 at 10:42AM AKDT until October 8 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected in
Unalaska.

* WHERE...Unalaska and Nikolski.

* WHEN...From 5 AM to 1 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong, gusty south winds will increase across
Unalaska, with the strongest winds expected early Thursday morning.
Winds will gradually diminish late Thursday morning.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
